timeout.description: Global timeout (seconds) for operations like socket I/O and DNS.

user.description: System user account under which the milter process runs (must have permission to access sockets and logs).

group.description: System group for the milter process.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for the milter-greylist process.

socket.description: Unix domain socket path used to communicate with the MTA (e.g., Postfix).

socket_mode.description: Octal permissions (e.g., '0660') for the milter socket file.

socket_owner.description: Owner of the socket file (typically the MTA user, e.g., postfix).

socket_group.description: Group of the socket file (typically the MTA group).

ratelimit.description: Maximum number of connections per IP per minute before triggering rate-limiting.

delay.description: Initial delay (seconds) before accepting a message from a new sender IP.

autowhitelist.description: Time (seconds, default 7 days) after successful delivery to automatically whitelist the sender IP.

autoblacklist.description: Time (seconds, default 1 day) after repeated greylist failures to automatically blacklist the IP.

greylist.description: Time (seconds) after which a greylisted sender is re-allowed if it retries.

greylistttl.description: Time (seconds, default 30 days) to remember successful deliveries (i.e., TTL of greylist entries).

loglevel.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (quiet) to 9 (very verbose); 4 is typical for production.

logfile.description: Optional path to a dedicated log file (if empty, uses syslog).

dns_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for DNS lookups (e.g., MX, SPF).

dns_retries.description: Number of DNS query retries before giving up.

ipv6.description: Enable or disable IPv6 support in DNS resolution and socket binding.

chroot.description: Optional chroot directory for sandboxing (must contain required binaries and libs).

whitelist.description: List of static entries to always bypass greylisting.

comment.description: Optional human-readable description for the entry.

network.description: Network in CIDR notation (e.g., '192.0.2.0/24') to whitelist.

email.description: Exact email address or domain (e.g., 'user@example.com' or '@example.com') to whitelist.

macro.description: Milter macro pattern (e.g., '{auth_authen}') to match milter context.

blacklist.description: List of static entries to always reject.

network.description: Network in CIDR notation to blacklist.

email.description: Exact email or domain to blacklist.

acls.description: List of named ACLs for fine-grained control of greylist behavior.

name.description: Unique name for the ACL (used in 'acl' directives).

ip.description: Single IP to include in this ACL.

network.description: Network in CIDR notation to include in this ACL.

email.description: Email or domain to include in this ACL.

regex.description: Regex to match entries in this ACL.

default_acl.description: Default action when no ACL matches: 'permit' (allow greylisting) or 'deny' (always reject).
